authorInstruction.title: Author Decision Reconciliation, Design Promotion and Canonical Prompt Publication
authorInstruction.authorizes: recording DQ-E3-1 to DQ-E3-16; reconciling and promoting the design to DESIGN — AUTHOR APPROVED; updating the canonical prompt, planning and roadmap records; documentary verification; publication of the documentary package to main

reconciliationCandidate: the direct child of e063a8a2 containing this file; identity, STATIC and publication reported with the publication

DQ-E3-1.decision: APPROVE R2: existing types, closed polylines; no new GeoElement; no new durable identity mechanism
DQ-E3-1.implementationDesign: outputs associated by parent algorithm and fixed output index (PAPER 0, FRAME 1, LABEL 2), serialized as ordered <output>

DQ-E3-2.decision: APPROVE INNER FRAME: paper boundary nominal ISO 216, hidden, authoritative, export rectangle; optional visible inner frame, margins left 20, right 10, top 10, bottom 10 mm (ISO 5457-style, no compliance claim); W_f = W_p - m_L - m_R > 0, H_f = H_p - m_T - m_B > 0; same conversion; no title block, sheet sets, paper space, viewports, G15

DQ-E3-3.decision: A0-A10 supported; frame default enabled A0-A4, disabled A5-A10; no silent margin reduction; impossible frame rejected with reason; paper valid independently; ISO 216 integers; A3 landscape 420 x 297 mm
DQ-E3-3.implementationDesign: only A10 portrait makes the frame impossible

DQ-E3-4.previous: index, Boolean, integer pair, literals; optional margin
DQ-E3-4.decision: explicit ordinary inputs; no live unit or scale read; explicit frame state; reproducible without GUI; no invented overloads
DQ-E3-4.signature: IsoABorder(<Point>, <ISO A index>, <Landscape>, <Scale numerator>, <Scale denominator>, <Model units per millimetre>, <Inner frame>)

DQ-E3-5.decision: ACCEPT subject to validation; u = 1e-3/fb(c); L = ((P*b)/a)*u
DQ-E3-5.implementationDesign: domains; exact integer pair; equivalent pairs bit-identical; absorption and non-finite results undefined; bit identity in tests; relative error <= 2^-50; PDF 0.001 pt, EMF 0.01 mm

DQ-E3-6.decision: GEOMETRY UNCHANGED; informed when physically inconsistent; condition (f_n/f_c)(s_n/s_c) = 1 within an explicit criterion; no persisted original-unit identifier; physical-size and scale-label coherence independent; no claim with unspecified unit; derived state only
DQ-E3-6.implementationDesign: f_c = 1e-3/u; E_i computed from captured inputs; COHERENT iff |E_i - P_i| <= 1e-6 mm; scale MATCH by exact normal-form equality

DQ-E3-7.decision: BLOCK CREATION with UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT; offer document units; no implicit mm or cm; valid usm supported

DQ-E3-8.decision: EXPLICIT PARTICIPATION ONLY; consent required; AQ-X2 precedence preserved; area = physical outer boundary, never the frame; hidden state does not prevent use; no second mechanism; no serialization

DQ-E3-9.decision: LIVE, EXPLICIT, SESSION-SCOPED LINKAGE; never labels or positions; validity rules for every lifecycle event; stale reference never activates another object; fallback rules apply; no persistent association; stop if a substantially wider change is needed
DQ-E3-9.implementationDesign: identity (==) scan of the live construction; no wider change needed

DQ-E3-10.previous: File action, session scale, computed once
DQ-E3-10.decision: PRESERVE THE SEPARATE PRODUCER CONTRACT; never merged; AQ-X2 unchanged; candidate 7.5 for unchanged details

DQ-E3-11.decision: CONSTRUCTIVE TEXT OUTPUT; captured size and scale; never the session scale; language-independent; placement accounts for the optional frame; no DXF text claim
DQ-E3-11.implementationDesign: anchor at the paper point m_R from the right and m_B from the bottom

DQ-E3-12.decision: APPROVE AND EXTEND: captured vs current scale and nominal vs effective physical size; status bar and export dialogs; DERIVED_TRANSIENT; explicit Use sheet scale; activation warning; no automatic geometry scaling

DQ-E3-13.decision: APPROVE THE CHARACTERIZED WORKFLOW: Construction > Annotations and media > ISO A Border; no toolbar button; frame option in the dialog (on A0-A4, off A5-A10); one undo point; optional explicit activation

DQ-E3-14.decision: APPROVE NAMING: IsoABorder, alias MarcoISOA; verify catalog against the base; no collision; preserve Classic behavior unless the compatibility contract requires otherwise

DQ-E3-15.decision: NO MIGRATION; macros stay behavioral references; Templatev7.ggb and baselines unchanged

DQ-E3-16.decision: APPROVE INTEGRATED_PHASE (PHASE + INTEGRATION), conditional on the reconciled scope; this documentary task DOCUMENTATION_STATUS_ONLY

OTQ-E3-1.disposition: shared kernel command available in GeoCeDG and Classic; GeoCeDG-specific GUI and export-area orchestration exclusive to GeoCeDG Desktop; no feature gate, no flag, no parallel Classic implementation

NUMERICAL-CONTRACT.disposition: expression and order unchanged; obligations A (bit-exact determinism), B (error vs captured u under normality of fl(q*u)), C (error vs physical definition under normality of u and fl(q*u)); 2^-50 only where derived; validity (undefined) separated from reliability (GUARANTEED / UNGUARANTEED); NOT_DETERMINABLE coherence when unreliable, non-finite or uncertainty above 1e-6 mm

retainedImplementationDesign.OTQ-E3-2: an undefined FRAME may be auxiliary in the Algebra View; undefined state explicit
retainedImplementationDesign.OTQ-E3-3: no coherence indicator for ISO_A_SELECTION without separate authorization
retainedImplementationDesign.OTQ-E3-4: frameless sheet moved through its reference point or by temporarily showing PAPER; no new dragging mechanism
